elements.element: Customer is subject to no non-compete restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still prohibits the Company from participating in any Internet project similar to the Site with respect to Deerskin Products.

elements.element: Customer is subject to no field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 gives HDI the exclusive right to use the “Deerskin” brand for a self-contained direct-to-consumer website, restricting the Company's use in that field.

elements.element: Any restriction is limited to a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to expressly named “Deerskin Products”; the prior extension to products “substantially similar” to Deerskin Products has been removed.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 introduces the operative restrictions with “during the term of this Agreement.”

elements.element: The restriction is capped at 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no 12-month cap. Its duration is tied to the Agreement term, which is not shown to be 12 months or less.

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to Customer's internal development activities.
elements.evidence: The proviso expressly states that the restriction does not apply to the Company's internal development activities.

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to businesses or products acquired by Customer.
elements.evidence: The proviso expressly excludes any business or products later acquired by the Company.

result.reason: The redline materially narrows the restriction and adds both required carve-outs, but it retains a non-compete and field-of-use exclusivity and omits the fallback's mandatory 12-month cap. It also adds an unnecessary automatic cessation remedy tied to HDI's performance, so it is not minimal. The drafting is generally operative but uses an awkward, lengthy construction and leaves some ambiguity over whether the opening term limitation governs the separate HDI exclusivity grant.
